errors.where: folding legs and X-braces under the seat
errors.what: The four feet and crossing tubes don't form one consistent frame: the lowest (nearest) foot sits in the middle front, while the side X-brace reads as front-facing. The legs don't share the seat's three-quarter view.

cards.fix: Camping chair in a consistent three-quarter view, two X-shaped leg braces on the left and right sides running front to back, four feet sitting at the corners of a rectangle drawn in the same perspective as the seat

errors.where: green bar stools in the water
errors.what: The stool seat tops are drawn as fairly flat ellipses, as if seen from near eye level, while the bar counter top and the pool are seen from well above. The two left stools also overlap and stack oddly.
The tile grid doesn't clearly shrink with distance the way the pool floor recedes.

cards.fix: Bar stools seen from the same high angle as the counter top, with rounder seat-top ellipses, evenly spaced along the curved bar, and pool floor tiles shrinking toward the back
